description: Submit free-text feedback about the API - a bug, an idea, a docs gap, a billing question, or anything else. Missing a tool? Use kind tool_request to tell us what you needed, with an optional tool_description. Tied to your key so we can follow up, but not a support-ticket SLA. Auth required; not billed.

category.description: Which area this concerns. Defaults to "other".

contact_ok.description: Optional, defaults to false. Whether we may follow up with you about this.

endpoint.description: Optional. Which /v1/* endpoint or MCP tool this is about, e.g. "/v1/ticket-lint".

kind.description: What this is. Defaults to "other". Use "tool_request" when a tool you needed does not exist.

message.description: What you want us to know. Up to 4000 characters.

tool_description.description: Only with kind "tool_request": what the missing tool should do, up to 500 characters.

name: send_feedback
